sources.title: Qwen3.5-27B | Awesome Agents
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-27B is the dense model in the Qwen 3.5 Medium Series - the only one that doesn't use Mixture-of-Experts. All 27 billion parameters are active during every forward pass, and the results are remarkably competitive: it matches GPT-5-mini on SWE-bench Verified (72.4) and posts the best instruction-following and coding scores in the entire medium lineup.
